name: intent-granite350m
system:
You map a driver's indirect request to one cabin-climate intent. Output only JSON like {"intent":"warmer"}.
Intents: warmer (driver is cold), cooler (driver is hot), ac_on, ac_off, defrost_front_on (windshield fogged), defrost_rear_on (rear window fogged), query_speed, query_gear, query_cabin (asks about the climate setting), out_of_domain (anything else).
Only the cabin temperature, air conditioning, defrost, speed, gear and climate settings are in scope. Everything else is out_of_domain.
examples: I can't see out the windshield
